name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
title: Tata Elxsi Ltd - 500408 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR993.8 cr, up 0.9% QoQ cc, with healthcare down 13.1% and FY27 growth cut to high single digit; margin gain mostly currency, not capacity discipline.

utilisation.quote: Yes, we are at 73% utilization. So, I think we can go all the way up to 80% or slightly more than 80%

triggers.label: FY27 growth cut to high single digit
triggers.quote: maybe, I would be a little more conservative and say maybe a higher single digit is what we should look at

triggers.label: Healthcare down 13.1% QoQ cc
triggers.quote: Our Healthcare and Life Sciences vertical de-grew by 13.1% quarter -on-quarter in constant currency terms

triggers.label: Utilisation 73%, room to 80%+
triggers.quote: we can go all the way up to 80% or slightly more than 80%

triggers.label: Aggressive competitor pricing in some bids
triggers.quote: there has been competition that has priced very, very aggressively, and we are also a little bit surprised

triggers.label: Automotive exit high-single digit
triggers.quote: maybe we would look at a high-single digit exit, may not get into a double-digit for automotive

guidance.value: higher single digit, not double digit
guidance.quote: we might be looking at a single digit, higher single digit growth for the financial year. We may not look at a double-digit growth
we want to take it to 27 in Q4 FY '27

prior_guidance_check.quote: those deals have not closed, and that resulted in this situation that we've had

red_flags.label: Margin gain mostly FX (155 bps of 130 bps net)
red_flags.quote: 150-155 basis points is coming from the currency movements

red_flags.label: Growth cut and healthcare deal slippage
red_flags.quote: Unfortunately for us, those deals have not closed

evasions.quote: We don't know whether it is because that they have used GenAI or they have assumed that GenAI will lead to certain productivity.
